name: Saoirse O'Malley
bio:
Saoirse O'Malley's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fixing up her father's tractor on their farm in County Cork. This practical experience ignited a passion for engineering that led her to a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Trinity College Dublin. After graduating, Saoirse started her career in the aerospace industry, quickly becoming disillusioned with the bureaucratic nature of the field. Craving a more dynamic environment, she transitioned to motorsport, joining a small Formula Ford team. Her methodical approach and sharp technical acumen quickly propelled her through the ranks. 

At Walkinshaw Andretti United, Saoirse is known for her meticulous attention to detail and her unwavering commitment to pushing the boundaries of car performance. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment, encouraging her team to challenge conventional thinking and explore innovative solutions. While demanding, she also prioritizes the development of her team members, mentoring junior engineers and fostering a culture of continuous learning. Her loyalty to the team and relentless pursuit of excellence make her a cornerstone of the organization.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, often tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Saoirse is a woman of average height with a no-nonsense demeanor, her sharp green eyes always observing.

quirks: Always carries a worn copy of 'Engineering Formulas' in her briefcase.
Insists on a perfectly aligned toolbox, organized by size and function.
Prefers to communicate complex data through hand-drawn diagrams on a whiteboard.
